{
  "sql": "
with t2022 as (select id from world_cup.world_cup.tournaments where tournament_year = 2022),
ko as (
  select m.id as match_id, m.stage, m.winner_team_id, m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id
  from world_cup.world_cup.matches m
  join t2022 on m.tournament_id = t2022.id
  where m.stage <> 'group'
),
stats as (
  select mts.match_id, mts.team_id, mts.possession_pct
  from world_cup.world_cup.match_team_statistics mts
  join ko on ko.match_id = mts.match_id
)
select ko.match_id, ko.stage,
  h.team_name as home_team, s1.possession_pct as home_poss,
  a.team_name as away_team, s2.possession_pct as away_poss,
  w.team_name as winner,
  case when s1.possession_pct > s2.possession_pct then h.team_name
       when s2.possession_pct > s1.possession_pct then a.team_name
       else 'tie' end as higher_possession_team
from ko
join world_cup.world_cup.teams h on h.id = ko.home_team_id
join world_cup.world_cup.teams a on a.id = ko.away_team_id
left join world_cup.world_cup.teams w on w.id = ko.winner_team_id
left join stats s1 on s1.match_id = ko.match_id and s1.team_id = ko.home_team_id
left join stats s2 on s2.match_id = ko.match_id and s2.team_id = ko.away_team_id
order by ko.match_id
",
  "rationale": "I pull every 2022 knockout match with each team's possession share and the actual winner so I can compare whether the team with more possession tended to win."
}
